# The Montessori House

> AMI-trained guides, mixed-age classrooms and real work for small hands, in a calm house in Ram Nagar.

## Key facts
- founded 2017
- 2 mixed-age environments

## Facilities
- Toddler community (1.5–2.5 yrs)
- Casa / Primary (2.5–6 yrs)
- AMI-certified guides
- Mixed-age classrooms
- Practical life
- Sensorial materials
- Language & maths
- Art & music
- Food preparation by children
- Festival celebrations
- Visits on weekends by appointment

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is The Montessori House?
Plot No. 1417A, 2nd Street, Ram Nagar North Extension, Madipakkam, Chennai 600 091.

### What facilities does The Montessori House have?
Toddler community (1.5–2.5 yrs), Casa / Primary (2.5–6 yrs), AMI-certified guides, Mixed-age classrooms, Practical life, Sensorial materials, Language & maths, Art & music, Food preparation by children, Festival celebrations, Visits on weekends by appointment.

### What ages do you take?
The toddler community is for 1.5 to 2.5 years; the primary (Casa) environment is for 2.5 to 6 years.

### Are your teachers Montessori-trained?
Yes. Our teachers hold certification from the Association Montessori Internationale (AMI).

### What are the school hours?
Weekdays 9.00 am to 12.00 noon.

### How do I visit The Montessori House?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 98402 42151.
